newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GF Namibia sees lead output end-April.
newsitem.headline: GF Namibia sees lead output end-April.

text.p: Gold Fields Namibia Ltd expects full production from its Ausmelt lead smelter at Tsumeb at the end of April, Tsumeb Corp Ltd (TCL) mine manager Tony de Beer said on Monday.
De Beer said the new lead smelter had gone through its commissioning process although some problems had been experienced with the chemical processes.
"Our biggest problem is to get the chemistry right because we use the same furnace to smelt as where they do reduction. I think we have come a long way down the line.
"We've got dirty concentrates and low grades. That (the chemical processes) has come right...actually I am very happy with the progress," De Beer said by telephone from Namibia.
He said full capacity of about 2,500 tonnes a month would be reached by end-April.
Gold Fields Namibia is part of the Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd group.
